body:
### Affected package

@terreno/ui

### Kind

Bug

### Problem

Light-mode `text.accent` (`accent700`, `#956A00`) measures 4.32:1 on `surface.baseAlternate` (`#F2F2F2`), below WCAG 1.4.3 AA (4.5:1) for normal text. It passes on `surface.base` (4.84:1) and in dark mode (6.23:1), so the failure only shows on alternate rows and inset panels. `text.accent` is used by CheckBox and the DateTimeActionSheet "today" label.

### Outcome

`text.accent` meets 4.5:1 on both `surface.base` and `surface.baseAlternate` in light and dark.

### Current behavior

1. Install `audit-color-schemes` from TerrenoLabs/terreno-skills, then from an app root (e.g. `example-frontend/`) run `bun <skill>/scripts/contrastAudit.ts`.
2. Row `text.accent on surface.baseAlternate`: light 4.32:1, FAIL light.

### Non-scope

- Accent fills (`border.activeAccent`, accent backgrounds).
- Dark-mode accent text.

### Acceptance

- `contrastAudit.ts` reports `text.accent` at ≥ 4.5:1 on `surface.base` and `surface.baseAlternate` in both modes.
- No demo story's axe scan reports `color-contrast` on accent text in light mode.

### Context

- Found by the `audit-color-schemes` skill (TerrenoLabs/terreno-skills#4).
- Related contrast issues: #1519, #1520, #1522.
title: [Bug]: Accent text fails contrast on baseAlternate in light mode

body:
### Affected package

@terreno/ui

### Kind

Bug

### Problem

The light-mode field focus border fails WCAG 1.4.11 (3:1 for state indicators). `field.borderFocus` and `border.focus` map to `primary200` (`#73CAE8`), which measures 1.85:1 on `surface.base` (`#FFFFFF`). Keyboard and low-vision users cannot reliably see which field has focus. Dark mode passes (6.63:1 on `#353535`).

### Outcome

The focused-field border and focus ring meet 3:1 against `surface.base` and `field.background` in light and dark mode.

### Current behavior

1. Install `audit-color-schemes` from TerrenoLabs/terreno-skills, then from an app root (e.g. `example-frontend/`) run `bun <skill>/scripts/contrastAudit.ts`.
2. Row `border.focus on surface.base`: light 1.85:1, dark 6.63:1, FAIL light.
3. Visually: `bun run demo:start`, open a TextField story with `theme=light`, tab into a field. The focused border is lighter than the unfocused `neutral500` border.

### Non-scope

- Focus rings on non-field controls that do not read `border.focus` / `field.borderFocus`.
- Dark-mode focus colors.

### Acceptance

- `contrastAudit.ts` reports `border.focus on surface.base` and `field.borderFocus` on `field.background` at ≥ 3:1 in both modes.
- A focused TextField in the light demo is visibly distinct from an unfocused one.

### Context

- Found by the `audit-color-schemes` skill (TerrenoLabs/terreno-skills#4).
- Related contrast issues: #1519, #1520, #1522.
title: [Bug]: Light-mode field focus border fails WCAG 3:1 contrast
